lead: # The model-agnostic agent runtime (epic #1078, P2). A LEAN binary — depends on the
# shared provider crate, NOT on src-tauri/tauri — so it spawns cheaply per session
sections.name: [[bin]]

lead: # Shared leaf utilities (#1646): base dir + epoch clock + civil-date formatting.
# `.claude/session.json` resolution — how a session that nobody configured finds out what it is.
# It lives beside `resolve_store_path` rather than in `bsc-util`, which is deliberately std-only.
# #3279: the worker's own open issues (stream-scoped) folded into each turn's system prompt — the
# on-plan context that replaced the #3278-removed todo injection.
# The file-structure engine, reused IN-PROCESS by the `list_files`/`file_info` tools (the standalone
# `bsc-files` binary is the same lib). Avoids a subprocess + the Windows binary-path resolution.
# The two-scope agent todo store (#1872): `render_active_from_env()` re-renders the active checklist's
# open items into EVERY turn's system prompt, so the plan survives a `compact_messages` elision.
# rustls-tls (no native-tls) + blocking — matches the research crate so the workspace
# resolves a single TLS backend. `webfetch` drives reqwest::blocking on a dedicated OS
# thread (the agent loop runs tools inline on a tokio worker; a nested runtime panics).
# `signal`: Ctrl+C cancels the running turn and closes the session (agent::interrupt).
# build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
